Four Step Workflow

How QueryMind Works

From connection string to verified data visualizations in minutes.

01

Connect Live Instance

Add your database connection string. Credentials are Fernet-encrypted at rest.

02

Ask in Plain English

Type natural questions. QueryMind extracts schema keywords and routes intent to LLM prompts.

03

Review AST Validation

Inspect the generated SQL alongside pre-flight EXPLAIN query cost estimates.

04

Explore & Export

Interact with auto-visualized data cards, ask follow-up questions, or export CSV/JSON.

Engine Capabilities

Built for Data Teams & Engineers

Safety guardrails paired with natural language query convenience.

⚡

Schema Keyword RAG

Jaccard similarity filters relevant tables from database schemas to build concise LLM context.

🛡️

sqlglot AST Guardrail

AST parsing blocks destructive statements (DROP, DELETE, UPDATE) prior to execution.

🔄

Self-Correction Loop

Automatic retries feed database dialect error tracebacks back to the LLM until valid SQL is produced.

📊

Smart Auto-Visualization

Query result sets auto-shape into scalar metric cards, bar charts, or paginated tables.

🔐

Fernet Encrypted Secrets

Database passwords locked with symmetric Fernet encryption before persisting.

💬

Multi-Turn Memory

Contextual conversation thread allows seamless follow-up query refinements.

Zero Compromise Security

Security & Safety Architecture

✓ SELECT-only AST

Zero Destructive Queries

sqlglot inspects every statement including nested CTEs to guarantee read-only safety.

⏱ Pre-flight EXPLAIN

Cost & Execution Bounds

Every query runs a preliminary EXPLAIN plan to estimate execution cost and row count.

🔑 Fernet Symmetric Encryption

Encrypted at Rest

Connection secrets are encrypted using Fernet keys and never stored in plain text.

🔐 OTP Passwordless Sign-In

Zero Password Leaks

Time-sensitive 6-digit email passcodes eliminate phishable password vulnerabilities.
